s: Part of MULAT BLISTT, this project develops a toolbox to monitor active and future landslides, establish soil-moisture thresholds, and support web- and SMS-based warnings and evacuation routing with UC, UP Baguio, University of Baguio, and local governments.
Part of the BOONDOCK program, DANUM develops technology-enhanced decision-support tools for water security and disaster resilience in indigenous communities.
BOONDOCK Project 3 assesses and manages upland rivers and springs, supporting water security and mountain engineering in areas including the Chico River Basin, Bontoc, and Tabuk.
Mapping dengue cases in Baguio City against housing, heat, and population data.
A 2021-2024 capacity-building project coordinated by Silesian University of Technology, with UC as a beneficiary, strengthening geomatics and disaster-risk-reduction teaching and research.

An EU-ASEAN SCOPE-HE project supporting Philippine and Malaysian higher-education institutions in developing doctoral education on digital transformation for natural hazards, including AI, machine learning, and IoT.

GIS and data analysis of road-safety risks in Baguio City. The project identified accident hotspots and time patterns and recommended targeted intersection redesign, improved street lighting, and traffic staffing.
A partnership among the City Government of Baguio, UC, SLU, UB, and the Department of Transportation to support research on low-carbon and alternative transportation networks.
